spans.s:
r. 10th cl. (ह्लापयति)
To speak, to speak articulately: also ह्रप.

(ई) ह्लादी r. 1st cl. (ह्लादते)
1 To gladden, to delight.
2 To be glad or delighted.
3 To sound, especially as a musical instrument.

m. (-दः)
Pleasure, joy.
E.
ह्लाद to be glad, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
Joy, delight.
E.
ह्लाद to be glad, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Delighted, happy.
E.
ह्लाद to be happy, क्त aff.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Happy, glad.
f. (-नी)
The Olibanum tree.
E.
ह्लाद pleasure, इनि and ङीष् affs.
